title: Your Celestial Soulmate
description: Look up at the stars! Answer 12 questions to discover which celestial being is your cosmic soulmate—from ancient gods to distant planets.

options.text: A lively rooftop party until dawn
Exploring an ancient temple at midnight

questions.text: When you face a challenge, you...

options.text: Shine brightest and lead the way
Adapt and flow like the tides
Twinkle patiently and wait for your moment

options.text: Shine your light for all to see

results.title: The Sun
results.description: Your celestial soulmate is THE SUN - the golden heart of the solar system! Like the sun, you are vibrant, energetic, and bring warmth to everyone around you. You're a natural leader who shines brightest when taking action. Your glow inspires others, and your passion burns eternal. People are drawn to your warmth and radiance.

results.title: The Moon
results.description: Your celestial soulmate is THE MOON - the gentle guardian of the night! Like the moon, you bring calm and comfort to those around you. You're intuitive, emotional, and incredibly nurturing. Your light may be softer, but it guides people through the darkest nights. You flow with life's tides while staying true to yourself.

results.title: The Aurora Borealis
results.description: Your celestial soulmate is THE AURORA BOREALIS - nature's most magical light show! You're a dreamer who sees magic in the ordinary. Your presence is ethereal and enchanting, leaving everyone around you spellbound. You bring wonder and color to a gray world. Like the northern lights, you're rare, beautiful, and utterly unique.

results.title: The North Star
results.description: Your celestial soulmate is THE NORTH STAR - the eternal guide for lost travelers! You're wise beyond your years, with a timeless quality that draws others to you. Like the star that never wavers, you're reliable, constant, and always point the way. Your connection with others transcends time and space.
